Alger, 12 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 12, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Google has rolled out version 5.0 of its TV operating system, based on Android 14. This update improves fluidity, personalization, and connectivity for compatible devices.
Google a rendu disponible la version 5.0: Google has made version 5.0 of Google TV available, which is built on Android 14. This update aims to optimize system responsiveness and navigation smoothness. An improved energy-saving mode helps reduce power consumption while maintaining peak performance.
L'écran d'accueil a été repensé pour off: The home screen has been redesigned to offer more flexible organization thanks to customizable widgets. The "For You" tab now centralizes personalized content. The ambient mode, assisted by artificial intelligence, makes it possible to display wallpapers generated from Google Photos or created by AI.
La nouvelle version introduit des profil: The new version introduces distinct multi-user profiles, including specific options for gamers and kids' profiles. The latter allow for screen time control and restricting access to certain content. Program recommendations thus adapt to each family member.
Côté connectivité, l'intégration avec Go: Regarding connectivity, integration with Google Home is enhanced. A new interface allows users to control smart home devices directly from the TV. Screen sharing between different devices in the home is also smoother.
Il est important de préciser que certain: It is important to note that certain technical advancements, notably compatibility with Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth Low Energy 5.3, require hardware modifications. These features will therefore only be available on future compatible models. Voice search via Google Assistant and the Gemini feature, which provides detailed information on the content being watched, complete this set of innovations designed to make the experience more intuitive.
